message.reasoning:
Assess. C1: good mission concept, users (marine/conservation scientists), rationale, references. Accomplished, ~8-9. C2: Gantt chart with tasks, but no contingency provision; adequate-to-accomplished. Plan fits mission, references sources. I'd say 7. C3: preliminary progress: STK tutorials, background research, no technical results/calculations. Adequate ~5. C4: presentation: clear structure, good writing, references as URLs, no formal reference list matching, short (~2-3 pages ok). Adequate ~6.

Requirements: R1 yes; R2 partial (plan mentions launch/orbit but no technical detail yet); R3 yes (STK chosen); R4 yes; R5 yes (useful links); R6 partial (tutorials, no results).
